chunks: Safwan al-Jammal narrated from Abi Ghurrah al-Khurasani, who said:
Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: "Wudu (ablution) before food and after it removes poverty."

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.الطَّعَامِ: food or meal before and after which the act is recommended
key_terms.الْفَقْرِ: poverty, want, or lack of material provision
key_terms.الْوُضُوءُ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing mentioned here in connection with eating
key_terms.يَذْهَبَانِ: they remove or take away, referring to the two acts together

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about doing wudu before and after eating?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette of eating: performing wudu (ablution) before and after الطعام. It presents this practice as a cause for the removal of poverty, linking ritual purity and daily conduct with blessing in one's livelihood.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4263 - Safwan al-Jammal narrated from Abi Ghurrah al-Khurasani who said that
Abu Abdillah (as) said: "Performing ablution before and after eating removes poverty."
